entity.summary: Former centralized cryptocurrency exchange that announced a strategic wind-down in December 2025, ceased all platform operations on January 30, 2026, and later disabled remaining withdrawal and account functions.
entity.notes: CoinCatch announced termination on 2025-12-24 and formally ceased platform operations on 2026-01-30. Limited self-service withdrawals remained temporarily available but did not constitute continued exchange operation; all withdrawal, account, API, and related functions were disabled on 2026-03-30. No unsupported launch date, legal jurisdiction, predecessor, successor, or incident cause is asserted.

events.title: CoinCatch announces service termination
events.description: CoinCatch announced a strategic wind-down and the orderly cessation of platform functions, including new registration, deposits, and trading services.
events.notes: The official announcement-center record is dated 2025-12-24.

events.title: CoinCatch platform operations cease
events.description: CoinCatch formally ceased all platform operations, with only a temporary limited self-service withdrawal function remaining during the wind-down.
events.notes: The final wind-down notice states that platform operations ceased on 2026-01-30; remaining withdrawals were disabled on 2026-03-30.

evidence.title: CoinCatch Service Termination Notice
evidence.notes: The official announcement center records the service-termination notice on 2025-12-24 and subsequent withdrawal and liquidation notices.

evidence.title: CoinCatch Final Wind-Down Notice
evidence.notes: The official final notice states that all platform operations ceased on 2026-01-30, limited withdrawals ended on 2026-03-30, and account, API, and related system functions were permanently disabled.
